template.name: seqdex/pool

params.label: One of the pool's two assets, held by its BASE coin
params.name: BASE

params.label: The other asset, held by its QUOTE coin
params.name: QUOTE

params.label: Bid: the pool buys BASE paying at most BID_NUM atoms of QUOTE for every BID_DEN atoms of BASE
params.name: BID_NUM

params.label: Bid denominator: BID_NUM atoms of QUOTE for every BID_DEN atoms of BASE
params.name: BID_DEN

params.label: Ask: the pool sells BASE asking at least ASK_NUM atoms of QUOTE for every ASK_DEN atoms of BASE
params.name: ASK_NUM

params.label: Ask denominator: ASK_NUM atoms of QUOTE for every ASK_DEN atoms of BASE
params.name: ASK_DEN

params.label: Least BASE a fill that pays BASE out leaves in the pool
params.name: RESERVE_BASE

params.label: Least QUOTE a fill that pays QUOTE out leaves in the pool
params.name: RESERVE_QUOTE

params.label: The maker's key, the only key that withdraws
params.name: MAKER_KEY

paths.effect: A fill in which the pool sells BASE: the BASE coin at input j, the pool's QUOTE coin at input j+1; outputs 2j and 2j+1 are the pool again at this same script. The pool pays out at least MIN_LOT of BASE, keeps at least RESERVE_BASE, and takes in at least ASK_NUM of QUOTE per ASK_DEN of BASE paid out. PATH is Left(true).
paths.name: sell

paths.effect: A fill in which the pool buys BASE: as sell, the pool taking in at least MIN_LOT of BASE and paying out at most BID_NUM of QUOTE per BID_DEN of BASE taken in, keeping at least RESERVE_QUOTE. PATH is Left(false).
paths.name: buy

paths.effect: The QUOTE coin beside a fill or a withdrawal: input j-1 is the pool's BASE coin at this same script, whose program judges the move. PATH is Right(Left(())).
paths.name: pair

paths.effect: The maker withdraws a coin of the pool, signing the whole transaction. PATH is Right(Right(())).
paths.name: withdraw

template.summary: A SeqDEX pool: a maker's two coins, one of each asset, that anyone fills from either side at the pool's bid and ask, never below its reserve, and that only the maker withdraws. No spend carries an annex.

sell.transaction: the pool's two coins, a payment coin and a fee coin; the pool again, the taker's base, the payment change, the fee change and the fee

pair.transaction: the quote coin beside the sell

withdraw.transaction: both coins and a fee coin; each coin to the maker, the fee change and the fee
